items.title: 63520_Ernie Fields oral history interview
items.q: So we found Tom and he was the only black policeman

ctx.x: or five, everybody was asleep and we asked a policeman--we finally ran into a policeman and we asked him where was a colored hotel, and of course he said he didn't know, he didn't know if they had any, but they had a colored policeman here. He said go down in that area and he explained just where to go, he said his name was Tom, he can explain to you where to go and where you can get lodging.

So we found Tom and he was the only black policeman, just a little token, so when we found him and asked him where there was a rooming house, he said we don't have that here and he went on and talked, he heard of the band and you all are going to play here tonight; we told him yes. So he said we have several negroes that have big homes and said they take in roomers and you could do that but we can't wake them up this time of morning, and he got to thinking, he said I'll tell you what, I can take you on to the…
when you get up; why not do that? He said I'll find you some rooms and everybody kind of looked at each other.
